card.name: Inside new brand drug names, and 'infusion'
card.fires_on: Partway through newer brand drug names such as HERNEXEOS, OJEMDA and tazarotene, mainly in dose-adjustment text. Also on the word 'infusion' after 'the duration of the' or 'end of the'.

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: A middle piece of a capitalized brand name or a drug name when it is repeated in dosing instructions.
modes.example: If recovered to ≤ Grade 1 in ≤ 4 weeks, resume HERN<<EX>>EOS at the reduced dose level.

modes.label: The word infusion
modes.description: The noun 'infusion' after 'the end of the' or 'the duration of the' in preparation or administration text.
modes.example: This change in rate will increase the total duration of the<< infusion>> but not the total dose.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of newer brand drug names and on the word 'infusion' in dosing and preparation instructions.
